text:
elena: Heads-up — planning a privilege-attenuation base-image cutover Thu 18:00 UTC. Need owners for: RBAC preflight, KMS signing integration, vuln triage, audit log ingestion, canary rollout + rollback play. Anyone available?

sam: I can own the runtime canary and smoke tests. Will run canary on staging + a single subset of prod with 5% traffic. Need the exact tag naming convention.

ranjit: I'll take RBAC preflight. I'll open a PR with role diffs and a script to validate. Quick Q: do we move image-builder SA to `image-builder-restricted` or add pod-level `fsGroup` restrictions? Prefer role-additive changes.

tara: Security ops here — cosign w/ KMS is our standard. Use KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/redwood-image-sign (key id: a1b2c3d4). We need audit events to include image digest + signing key fingerprint. Splunk ingestion must be ready.

security-bot: vuln-scan: base-image `redwood/base:202401` flagged CVE-2023-XXXX in openssl (<1.1.1k). Severity: high. Suggested action: bump openssl to patched release, rebuild base, regenerate SBOM. Refer /scans/1718899999.

sam: Good catch. Canary will use patched base. I'll coordinate tagging: `redwood/runtime:2026-03-24-attenuated-v1` and we'll pin manifests to digests for canary.

build-bot: automated-build: started repro for `redwood/base:202403` -> build failed on `libsec` unit test. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/3321 (link).

ranjit: Preflight checklist (short):
- ensure cluster role `image-puller` unchanged
- validate RBAC run: `kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:infra:image-builder`
- run `kubevulnscan` on canary images
- ensure PodSecurityContext `runAsNonRoot: true` + dropCapabilities: ALL
I'll add infra/scripts/rbac-check.sh and a small e2e smoke that asserts `runsAsNonRoot`.

(elena pinned a checklist)

Code snippets:
```bash
# cosign sign with AWS KMS (example)
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key aws-kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/a1b2c3d4 redwood/runtime:2026-03-24-attenuated-v1

# preflight RBAC check
kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:infra:image-builder --namespace=prod
```

ops-oncall: Oncall notes — if canary error rate >1% or latency spike >50ms for 3 consecutive minutes, trigger rollback: re-tag previous digest as `redwood/runtime:canary-rollback-171890XXX` and route traffic back to previous pool. Collect diagnostics: `kubectl get events`, `kubectl describe pod`, container runtime logs, image pull & cosign verification failures.

tara: Audit logging: ensure CRI/runtime events include `image.digest`, `signature.key_id`, and `user.principal`. We'll add those fields to the forwarder mapping to Splunk; pinging infra for a config rollout.

elena: Assignments: sam (canary + tag + smoke), ranjit (RBAC preflight + script + PR), tara (KMS signing + audit mapping), security-bot will re-run scan post-build. Timeline: base rebuild by Wed EOD, canary Thu 18:00 UTC. If anything blocks, escalate to @ops-oncall. :eyes: 

sam: I'll also add a quick rollback playbook to the runbook (steps, who to page, useful queries).

ranjit: One more Q: are we enabling immutable tags for the repo during cutover? Prevent accidental `latest` pushes. If yes, infra needs to allow retag-only for rollout account.

tara: Yes, enforce immutability for prod image repo during cutover. We'll allow a curated service account to push signed images only.

elena: Thanks — I'll schedule a 30m ops-check-in Wed 16:00 UTC to validate artifacts and smoke results. Posting the checklist here after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
